verses.27:20: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيۡرَ فَقَالَ مَالِيَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلۡهُدۡهُدَ أَمۡ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَآئِبِينَ

meaning: The hudhud (hoopoe), the bird named in 27:20 in the account of Sulayman. Quadriliteral onomatopoeic root; classical lexica treat it under the doubled biliteral هد.
en_note: Single occurrence; gloss from lexica, not co-occurrence statistics.
